verdict.rationale: The Orama JS docs show documents being inserted incrementally into an existing database instance via `insert`/`insertMultiple`, with no rebuild step. The Cloud docs say each data source can be updated, deleted from, or added to without affecting other data sources, which implies incremental changes rather than a full reindex. Missing for 10: explicit update and delete APIs in the open-source library, any statement that changes become searchable in near real time (latency/visibility guarantees), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
